events.title: Burlington Farmers Market
events.summary: Shop local produce, prepared food and handmade goods at the Lions Club market.
events.details: The Burlington Lions Club lists the market on Wednesdays, Fridays and Saturdays through October. This card uses the event-specific hours published for August 26.
bring: A way to keep cold items chilled

events.title: Watch Burlington’s partial lunar eclipse
events.dateLabel: Thu, Aug. 27 · partial phase at 10:33 p.m.
events.location: Visible across Burlington with a clear view of the sky
events.summary: The partial eclipse begins at 10:33 p.m. and reaches maximum at 12:12 a.m.
events.details: The penumbral phase starts at 9:23 p.m. The partial phase starts at 10:33 p.m., reaches maximum at 12:12 a.m. and ends at 1:51 a.m. No eye protection is required for a lunar eclipse.
events.imageAlt: Illustration of a partial lunar eclipse above Lake Ontario

events.title: Canada’s Largest Ribfest
events.summary: Four days of rib teams, music and fundraising on Burlington’s waterfront.
events.details: The festival runs 11 a.m. to 11 p.m. Friday through Sunday and 11 a.m. to 7 p.m. Monday. Food and drinks cost extra after admission.
bring: A plan for transit or parking
events.imageAlt: Ribs cooking over a barbecue pit
events.credit: Thogru via Wikimedia Commons · CC BY-SA 3.0

events.title: Supercrawl
events.summary: A free weekend of music, art and street programming about 20 minutes from Burlington.
events.details: This is a nearby Hamilton pick, not a Burlington event. Check the official schedule before leaving because set times and road closures can change.

events.title: Patrick Watson under the harvest moon
events.summary: An outdoor fall concert in the garden. General admission doors open at 5:30 p.m.
events.details: General admission seating is on the turf and chairs are not supplied. The event is outdoors and may be postponed, rescheduled or cancelled for weather.
events.imageAlt: Rock Garden at Royal Botanical Gardens
events.credit: Nhl4hamilton via Wikimedia Commons · public domain

events.title: Plant 500 native trees at Longmoor Park
events.summary: BurlingtonGreen and City forestry staff are planning a community planting morning.
events.details: The organizers plan to plant more than 500 native trees. Space is limited and registration was not yet open when this listing was checked.
events.imageAlt: Illustration of neighbours volunteering on a Burlington park path

boredIdeas.title: Catch golden hour at the Brant Street Pier
boredIdeas.copy: Walk to the end of the pier and watch the lake change colour before sunset.
boredIdeas.imageAlt: Burlington News visual of Brant Street Pier at sunset

boredIdeas.title: Find the Moon before Thursday’s eclipse
boredIdeas.copy: Use tonight to find a clear view. The partial phase begins Thursday at 10:33 p.m.
boredIdeas.imageAlt: Illustration of a partial lunar eclipse

boredIdeas.title: Find three pieces of public art downtown
boredIdeas.copy: Choose three works you normally walk past and look long enough to notice one new detail in each.
